en: Pressing chest pain, worsens with physical exertion or stress, angina type.
uzL: Ko'krakda bosuvchi og'riq, jismoniy zo'riqishda yoki stressda kuchayadi, stenokardiya tipi.

en: Shortness of breath, worsens climbing stairs and lying down, heart failure suspected.
uzL: Nafas qisilishi, zinadan chiqishda va yotganda kuchayadi, yurak etishmovchiligi shubha.

en: Angina: chest tightness with physical activity, relieved by rest or nitrates.
uzL: Stenokardiya: jismoniy harakatda ko'krak siqilishi, dam olishda yoki nitratdan yaxshilanadi.

en: Heart failure symptoms — swelling, shortness of breath, fatigue.
uzL: Yurak etishmovchiligi alomatlari — shish, nafas qisilishi, charchash.

en: Arrhythmia, irregular heartbeat, "fluttering" or "dropping" sensation.
uzL: Aritmiya, yurak urishi notekis, "qo'tirib qo'yadi" yoki "tushib qoladi" hissi.

en: Acute chest pain, prolonged, MI suspected, urgent evaluation needed.
uzL: O'tkir ko'krak og'rig'i, uzoq davom etadi, infarkt ekv. va tez tekshiruv kerak.

en: Stent placed or CABG performed, recent chest pain or shortness of breath.
uzL: Stent qo'yilgan yoki ShAKB o'tkazilgan, oxirgi vaqtda yana ko'krak og'rig'i yoki nafas qisilishi.

en: Heart murmur, sound on auscultation, new or changed.
uzL: Yurak shovqini, auskultatsiyada ovoz, yangi yoki o'zgargan.

en: Hypertensive crisis: sharply elevated pressure, headache, nausea.
uzL: Gipertenziya krizisi: bosim keskin ko'tarilgan, bosh og'rig'i, ko'ngil aynishi.

en: Bradycardia or very slow pulse, fatigue, dizziness.
uzL: Bradikardiya yoki puls juda past, charchash, bosh aylanishi.

en: Cardiac syncope: fainting during exertion or suddenly.
uzL: Kardiyak sinkop: zo'riqishda yoki to'satdan hushdan ketish.

en: Pericarditis: chest pain worse when lying down.
uzL: Perikardit: ko'krak og'rig'i yotganda kuchayadi.

en: Rapid heartbeat, arrhythmia sensation, "skipping beats" feeling.
uzL: Yurak tez urishi, aritmiya hissi, "urib qo'yadi" deb ta'riflaydi.

en: Pleurisy or pneumonia suspected — pain with breathing.
uzL: Plevrit yoki pnevmoniya ekv. — nafasda og'riq.

en: Cardiac implant (pacemaker, ICD) in place.
uzL: Yurak implant (EKS, ICD) o'rnatilgan.

en: Venous thrombosis or embolism history.
uzL: Vena trombozi yoki emboliya tarixi.

en: Cardiac evaluation and stress test needed.
uzL: Kardiologik tekshiruv va stress-test kerak.

en: Swelling in lower legs, worsens by evening, both legs.
uzL: Pastki oyoqlarda shish, kun oxirida kuchayadi, ikkala oyoqda.

en: Dizziness, fainting episodes, syncope or presyncope.
uzL: Bosh aylanishi, hushdan ketish xurujlari, sinkop yoki presinkop.

en: Headache with elevated blood pressure, temporal or diffuse.
uzL: Qon bosimi ko'tarilishi bilan bosh og'rig'i, ensa sohasida yoki diffuz.

en: Nocturnal dyspnea, difficulty breathing lying down, sleeps with 2-3 pillows.
uzL: Tunda bo'g'ilish, yotganda nafas qiyin, 2-3 yostiqda uxlaydi.

en: Chest pain radiating to left arm, jaw or neck, MI suspected.
uzL: Ko'krak og'rig'i chap qo'l, jag' yoki bo'yinga tarqaladi, infarkt ekv.

en: Weakness, easy fatigue, exhaustion, intolerant to physical exertion.
uzL: Zaiflik, tez charchash, kuchsizlik, jismoniy zo'riqishga chidamsiz.

en: High blood pressure, consistently high at home, uncontrolled.
uzL: Qon bosimi yuqori, uyda o'lchaganda ham barqaror yuqori, nazoratsiz.

en: Hypertension diagnosed several years ago, not following treatment regimen.
uzL: Arterial gipertenziya bir necha yil oldin qo'yilgan, davolash rejimiga rioya qilmaydi.

en: Family history of coronary disease, MI or stroke.
uzL: Oilada yurak ishemiyasi, infarkt yoki insult bor.

en: Arrhythmia (fibrillation etc.) treated, taking anticoagulants.
uzL: Aritmiya (fibrilatsiya va boshqalar) davolangan, antikoagulyantlar qabul qiladi.

en: Heart failure (CHF), on diuretics and other medications.
uzL: Yurak etishmovchiligi (XSN), diuretiklar va boshqa dorilar rejimida.

en: ECG or Echo previously showed abnormalities.
uzL: EKG yoki EchoKG da ilgari o'zgarishlar aniqlangan.

en: Stent placed or CABG performed, rehabilitation completed.
uzL: Stent qo'yilgan yoki ShAKB o'tkazilgan, reabilitatsiya o'tgan.

en: Diabetes or metabolic syndrome together, overweight.
uzL: Diabet yoki metabolik sindrom bilan birga, vazn ortiqcha.

en: Sleep apnea suspected or using CPAP.
uzL: Uyqu apnoe shubha yoki CPAP ishlatadi.

en: Blood lipids high, taking statins.
uzL: Qon lipidlari yuqori, statinlar qabul qiladi.

en: Smoking history over 10 years.
uzL: Chekish staji 10 yildan ortiq.

en: Low physical activity, mainly sedentary lifestyle.
uzL: Jismoniy faollik kam, asosan o'tirish turmush tarzi.

en: Dyslipidemia identified, taking statins but LDL still high.
uzL: Dislipidemiya aniqlangan, statinlar qabul qiladi lekin LDL hali yuqori.

en: Angina or coronary disease under cardiologist monitoring.
uzL: Stenokardiya yoki yurak ishemiyasi bo'yicha kardiolog kuzatuvda.

en: Blood pressure not regularly measured at home or consistently high.
uzL: Qon bosimi uyda muntazam o'lchanmaydi yoki barqaror yuqori.

en: Cardiac complaints worsened after URI or infection.
uzL: O'RVI yoki infeksiyadan keyin yurak sohasida shikoyatlar kuchaygan.

en: Emotional stress triggers chest pain.
uzL: Emosional stressda ko'krak og'rig'i paydo bo'ladi.

en: Acute MI experienced, stent placed or conservative treatment.
uzL: O'tkir miokard infarkti o'tkazgan, stent qo'yilgan yoki konservativ davolangan.

en: Skin rash, itching, redness, various locations.
uzL: Terida toshma, qichishish, qizarish, turli joylarda.

en: Severe itching, disturbs sleep at night.
uzL: Qichishish kuchli, tunda uyqu buziladi.

en: Acute or chronic urticaria.
uzL: O'tkir yoki surunkali urtikariya.

en: Acne, face or body.
uzL: Akne, yuzda yoki tanada.

en: Psoriasis suspected, plaques, scaling.
uzL: Psoriaz shubha, plaklar, qotish.

en: Fungal infection (mycosis), foot or nail.
uzL: Gribok (mikoz), oyoq yoki tirnoq.

en: Dermatological evaluation and biopsy needed.
uzL: Dermatologik tekshiruv va biopsiya kerak.

en: Pustules or blisters, purulent or fluid-filled.
uzL: Pustula yoki pufakchalar, yiringli yoki suyuq.

en: Pigmentation changes, dark or light spots.
uzL: Pigment o'zgarishi, qorong'u yoki och dog'lar.

en: Dry skin, scaling, swelling.
uzL: Teri quruq, qotish, shishilish.

en: Hair loss, or beard/eyebrows.
uzL: Soch to'kilishi, yoki soqol/qosh.

en: Nail changes, color, layering, fungus.
uzL: Tirnoq o'zgarishi, rang, qatlamlanish, mog'or.

en: Wound or eczema prolonged, not responding to treatment.
uzL: Yara yoki eksema uzoq davom etadi, davolashga javob bermaydi.

en: Allergic dermatitis, contact with allergen.
uzL: Allergik dermatit, allergen bilan aloqa.

en: Bacterial or infectious agent suspected.
uzL: Bakterial yoki qo'zg'atuvchi infektsiya shubha.

en: Chronic skin disease, eczema or psoriasis.
uzL: Terida surunkali kasallik, ekzema yoki psoriaz.

en: Allergy history positive, drug or food.
uzL: Allergiya anamnezi, dori yoki ovqatga.

en: Working in sun exposure or outdoors for long time.
uzL: Quyosh ta'sirida ishlash yoki ko'p vaqt ochiq.

en: Dermatologist treated, recurrence or new rash.
uzL: Dermatolog davolagan, recidiv yoki yangi toshma.

en: Long-term steroid cream use.
uzL: Steroid kremlar uzoq ishlatgan.

en: Thirst, polydipsia, frequent urination (polyuria), diabetes symptoms.
uzL: Chanqash, polidipsiya, tez-tez siyish (poliuriya), diabet alomatlari.

en: Weight loss or gain, appetite changes, chronic.
uzL: Vazn yo'qotish yoki ortishi, ishtaba o'zgarishi, surunkali.

en: Diabetic retinopathy or nephropathy identified, monitoring needed.
uzL: Diabetik retinopatiya yoki nefropatiya aniqlangan, nazorat kerak.

en: Hormonal imbalance, menstrual and libido changes, fatigue.
uzL: Gormon disbalansi, hayz va libido o'zgarishi, charchoq.

en: Thyroid nodules or cysts, evaluation or monitoring needed.
uzL: Qalqonsimon bez nodullari yoki kistalar, tekshiruv yoki kuzatuv kerak.

en: Insulin resistance, metabolic syndrome, with overweight.
uzL: Insulin rezistentligi, metabolik sindrom, vazn ortiqcha bilan.

en: Adrenal insufficiency suspected, weakness, pigmentation.
uzL: Adrenal yetishmovchilik shubha, zaiflik, pigmentatsiya.

en: Osteoporosis, fracture risk.
uzL: Osteoporoz, suyak sinishi xavfi.

en: Cushing or pheochromocytoma suspected.
uzL: Cushing yoki feyoxromotsitoma ekv.

en: Foot-hand numbness, diabetic neuropathy symptoms, worse at night.
uzL: Oyoq-qo'l uvishishi, diabetik neyropatiya alomatlari, kechasi kuchayadi.

en: Dry skin, hair loss, nail changes, hormonal or metabolic.
uzL: Teri quruqligi, soch to'kilishi, tirnoklar o'zgarishi, gormon yoki metabolik.

en: Intolerance to heat or cold, skin changes.
uzL: Issiq yoki sovuqqa toqat qilmaslik, teri o'zgarishi.

en: Swelling in front of neck, thyroid enlarged, hyperthyroidism or nodule.
uzL: Bo'yin oldida bo'rtma, qalqonsimon bez kattalashgan, gipertiroidizm yoki nodul.

en: Menstrual cycle disorder, infertility, hormonal imbalance suspected.
uzL: Hayz sikli buzilishi, bepushtlik, gormon disbalansi shubha.

en: Sleepiness, bradycardia or conversely rapid heartbeat, hypothyroidism/hyperthyroidism.
uzL: Uyquchanlik, bradikardiya yoki aksincha yurak tez urishi, gipotireoz/gipertiroidizm.

en: High blood sugar, uncontrolled diabetes, high at home too.
uzL: Qand qoni yuqori, diabet nazoratsiz, uyda o'lchaganda ham yuqori.

en: Hypoglycemia: sweating, tremor, hunger feeling, weakness — quickly improves with food.
uzL: Gipoglikemiya: terlash, titroq, ochlik hissi, zaiflik — tez oziq-ovqatdan yaxshilanadi.

en: Diabetes diagnosed several years ago, control insufficient.
uzL: Qandli diabet bir necha yil oldin qo'yilgan, nazorat yetarli emas.

en: Not fully following insulin or oral medication regimen.
uzL: Insulin yoki peroral dori rejimiga to'liq rioya qilmaydi.

en: Diabetic neuropathy or retinopathy identified, fundus examined.
uzL: Diabetik neyropatiya yoki retinopatiya aniqlangan, ko'z tubi tekshirilgan.

en: Nephropathy suspected, albuminuria or creatinine elevated.
uzL: Nefropatiya shubha, albuminuriya yoki kreatinin oshgan.

en: Blood sugar frequently measured at home, results variable.
uzL: Qand qoni uyda tez-tez o'lchanadi, natijalar o'zgaruvchan.

en: Family history of diabetes, thyroid or other endocrine disease.
uzL: Oilada diabet, tiroid yoki boshqa endokrin kasallik bor.

en: Thyroid previously evaluated or treated.
uzL: Qalqonsimon bez bo'yicha avval tekshiruvdan o'tgan yoki davolangan.

en: Weight and appetite changed sharply in recent months.
uzL: Oxirgi oylarda vazn va ishtaba keskin o'zgardi.

en: Polyuria and polydipsia symptoms gradually appeared.
uzL: Poliuriya va polidipsiya simptomlari asta-sekin paydo bo'lgan.

en: Hypoglycemia episodes observed, cause not identified.
uzL: Gipoglikemiya epizodlari kuzatilgan, sababi aniqlanmagan.

en: Women have menstrual cycle disorder or infertility complaint.
uzL: Ayollarda hayz sikli buzilishi yoki bepushtlik shikoyati bor.

en: Long-term steroid medication use.
uzL: Steroid dorilarni uzoq muddat qabul qilgan.

en: Thyroid function low (hypothyroidism) or high (hyperthyroidism) treated.
uzL: Tiroid funksiyasi past (gipotireoz) yoki yuqori (gipertiroidizm) davolangan.

en: Ear pain, in one or both ears.
uzL: Quloq og'rig'i, bir yoki ikkala qulochda.

en: Ear discharge or noise, hearing decreased.
uzL: Quloqdan ajralma yoki shovqin, eshitish pasaygan.

en: Throat pain, worsens with swallowing.
uzL: Burning og'rig'i, yutishda kuchayadi.

en: Nasal congestion, discharge, allergy or infection.
uzL: Burun tiqilishi, oqim, allergiya yoki infeksiya.

en: Voice changes, hoarseness.
uzL: Bosh ovozi o'zgarishi, xirillash.

en: Nasal itching or nosebleed.
uzL: Burning qichishishi yoki qon ketishi.

en: Vertigo, dizziness, ear-related.
uzL: Vertigo, bosh aylanishi, quloq bilan bog'liq.

en: Tonsillitis: sore throat, fever.
uzL: Tonsillit: bo'g'oz og'rig'i, isitma.

en: Sinusitis suspected: forehead pain, nasal congestion.
uzL: Sinusit shubha: peshana og'rig'i, burun tiqilishi.

en: ENT evaluation needed.
uzL: LOR tekshiruv kerak.

en: Chronic tonsillitis or sinusitis.
uzL: Surunkali tonzillit yoki sinusit.

en: Hearing decreased, using device.
uzL: Eshitish pasaygan, apparat ishlatadi.

en: Allergic rhinitis or polyposis.
uzL: Allergik rinit yoki polipoz.

en: Abdominal pain, mainly epigastric, worsens after meals and at night on an empty stomach.
uzL: Qorin og'riqi, asosan epigastriyada, ovqatdan keyin kuchayadi va kechasi och qoringa og'riq.

en: Nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, slight weight loss.
uzL: Ko'ngil aynishi, qusish, ishtaha yo'q, vazn biroz tushgan.

en: Vomiting blood or black material, upper GI bleeding suspected.
uzL: Qusish qon aralash yoki qora, yuqori yo'l qon ketishi shubha.

en: Pancreatitis suspected: abdominal pain radiating to back, vomiting, severe.
uzL: Pankreatit shubha: qorin og'rig'i belga tarqaladi, qusish, og'ir.

en: Gastritis or peptic ulcer (PUD) symptoms, improves with PPI.
uzL: Gastrit yoki oshqozon yarasi (YAB) alomatlari, PPI dan keyin yaxshilanadi.

en: Gallbladder area pain, gallstone or cholecystitis suspected.
uzL: O't pufagi sohasida og'riq, o't toshi yoki xoletsistit shubha.

en: Functional dyspepsia, postprandial fullness, gas.
uzL: Funktsional dispepsiya, ovqatdan keyin qorin to'lib qoladi, gaz.

en: Heaviness in liver area, hepatitis or liver disease suspected.
uzL: Jigar sohasida og'irlik, gepatit yoki jigar kasalligi ekv.

en: Intestinal peristalsis disorder, abdominal distension, after meals.
uzL: Ichak peristaltikasi buzilishi, qorincha shishi, ovqatdan keyin.

en: Loss of appetite, weight loss, chronic GI or general complaint.
uzL: Ishtaha yo'qotish, vazn tushishi, surunkali oshqozon-ichak yoki umumiy shikoyat.

en: H. pylori or reflux treated, symptoms returned or monitoring needed.
uzL: X.pylori yoki reflyuks davolangan, shikoyatlar qaytgan yoki nazorat kerak.

en: Hemorrhoids, blood in stool, pain during bowel movement.
uzL: Gemorroy, najasda qon, og'riq, ichak bo'shishda.

en: Alternating constipation and diarrhea, abdominal bloating, gas.
uzL: Qabziyat va ich ketish almashinib turadi, qorin dam bo'lishi, gaz.

en: Intestinal spasms, alternating with constipation.
uzL: Ichak burmalari (spazm), qabziyat bilan almashinadi.

en: Peptic ulcer perforation suspected — urgent surgery needed.
uzL: Oshqozon yarasi perforatsiyasi ekv. — tez jarrohlik kerak.

en: Bile duct obstruction, yellowing, itching.
uzL: O't yo'llari to'silishi, sariq rang, qotish.

en: Acute or chronic pancreatitis, alcohol history.
uzL: Pankreatit o'tkir yoki surunkali, alkogol anamnezi.

en: Celiac or food intolerance suspected.
uzL: Seliak yoki oziq-ovqat intoleransiyasi shubha.

en: Gastric emptying disorder (gastroparesis).
uzL: Oshqozon o'tkazuvchanligi buzilishi (gastroparezi).

en: Gastroscopy or colonoscopy results available.
uzL: Gastroskopiya yoki kolonoskopiya natijasi mavjud.

en: Burning behind sternum, acid reflux, retrosternal burning.
uzL: Ko'krak ortida achishish, nordon kekirish, reflyuks alomatlari, sternum ortida kuydiradi.

en: Pressing epigastric pain, worse at night and on empty stomach, peptic ulcer suspected.
uzL: Epigastriyada bosuvchi og'riq, kecha va och qoringa xususiy, oshqozon yarasi shubha.

en: Blood or black stool (melena) appeared, hemorrhoids or upper GI bleeding suspected.
uzL: Najasda qon yoki qora (melena) paydo bo'ldi, gemorroy yoki yuqori yo'l shubha.

en: Heaviness under right rib cage, dull pain, gallbladder or bile duct related.
uzL: O'ng qovurg'a ostida og'irlik, to'qib og'riq, o't pufagi yoki o't yo'llari bilan bog'liq.

en: Gastroesophageal reflux, postprandial discomfort, dyspepsia.
uzL: Oshqozon-ichak reflyuksi, ovqatdan keyin noqulaylik, dispepsiya.

en: Difficulty swallowing (dysphagia), with solid food or liquids.
uzL: Yutish qiyinlashishi (disfagiya), qattiq ovqatda yoki suyuqlikda.

en: Yellow discoloration, stool color change, liver or bile duct suspected.
uzL: Sariq rang, najas rangining o'zgarishi, jigar yoki o't yo'llari shubha.

en: Complaints started about 6 months ago, gradually worsening.
uzL: Shikoyatlar taxminan 6 oy oldin boshlangan, asta-sekin kuchayib bormoqda.

en: Dietary irregularities and fatty foods worsen dyspepsia.
uzL: Ovqat rejimi buzilganda va yog'li ovqatdan keyin dispepsiya kuchayadi.

en: Reflux esophagitis prolonged, taking PPI.
uzL: Reflyuks oezofagit uzoq davom etadi, PPI qabul qiladi.

en: H. pylori identified, eradication treated or needs treatment.
uzL: X.pylori aniqlangan, eradikatsiya davolangan yoki davolash kerak.

en: Peptic ulcer (PUD) history, recurrence or healed ulcer.
uzL: Oshqozon yarasi (YAB) tarixi, recidiv yoki yara yopilgan.

en: Chronic gastritis or duodenitis, follows diet.
uzL: Surunkali gastrit yoki duodenit, parhezga rioya qiladi.

en: Liver, bile duct or pancreas disease history.
uzL: Jigar, o't yo'llari yoki pankreas kasalligi anamnezi bor.

en: Long-term antibiotics or PPI use, currently continuing.
uzL: Antibiotiklar yoki PPI uzoq qabul qilgan, hozir ham davom etmoqda.

en: Alcohol consumption present, amount and duration.
uzL: Alkogol iste'moli mavjud, miqdori va davomiyligi.

en: Weight lost or gained in recent months.
uzL: Vazn tushgan yoki ortgan, oxirgi oylarda.

en: Intestinal inflammation (Crohn, UC) suspected or in family.
uzL: Ichak yallig'lanishi (Krohn, YABK) ekv. yoki oilada.

en: B12 or iron deficiency identified.
uzL: B12 yoki temir yetishmovchiligi aniqlangan.

en: Previously treated for GI disease, complete remission not achieved.
uzL: Ilgari oshqozon-ichak kasalliklari bo'yicha davolangan, to'liq remissiya bo'lmagan.

en: Diet: fatty, fried foods excessive.
uzL: Parhez: yog'li, qovurilgan ovqat ko'p.

en: Long-term use of NSAIDs or pain relievers.
uzL: NSAID yoki og'riq qoldiruvchi dorilarni uzoq muddat qabul qilgan.

en: Smoking, excessive tea or coffee consumption.
uzL: Chekish, choy yoki kofe ko'p iste'mol qiladi.

en: Family history of peptic ulcer or gallbladder disease.
uzL: Oilada oshqozon yarasi yoki o't pufagi kasalligi bor.

en: Appendectomy or other surgical intervention performed.
uzL: Appendektomiya yoki boshqa jarrohlik aralashuvi o'tkazilgan.

en: Symptoms clearly worsen during stressful periods.
uzL: Stress davrlarida shikoyatlar aniq kuchayadi.

en: Gastroscopy not performed for long time or colonoscopy recommended.
uzL: Gastroskopiya uzoq o'tkazilmagan yoki kolonoskopiya tavsiya etilgan.

en: Gallbladder removed (cholecystectomy), changes still present.
uzL: O't pufagi olib tashlangan (xoletsistektomiya), keyin ham o'zgarishlar bor.

en: Lower abdominal pain, during menstruation or constant.
uzL: Qorin ostida og'riq, hayz davrida yoki doimiy.

en: Menstrual cycle disorder, delay or excessive bleeding.
uzL: Hayz sikli buzilishi, kechikish yoki ortiqcha qon ketish.

en: Gynecological evaluation and ultrasound needed.
uzL: Ginekologik tekshiruv va USG kerak.

en: Infertility, cannot conceive for long time.
uzL: Bepushtlik, uzoq vaqt homilador bo'la olmaydi.

en: Vaginal discharge changes, odor or color.
uzL: Vaginal ajralma o'zgarishi, hid yoki rang.

en: Nausea, vomiting, pregnancy suspected.
uzL: Ko'ngil aynishi, qusish, homiladorlik shubha.

en: Menopause symptoms: hot flashes, mood changes.
uzL: Klimaks alomatlari: issiq basish, kayfiyat o'zgarishi.

en: Breast pain or swelling, before menstruation.
uzL: Ko'krak og'rig'i yoki shishi, hayz oldida.

en: Pain during intercourse (dyspareunia).
uzL: Jinsiy aloqada og'riq (dispareuniya).

en: Uterus or appendix area swelling suspected.
uzL: Bachadon yoki appendiks sohasida bo'rtma shubha.

en: Endometriosis or fibroid suspected.
uzL: Endometrioz yoki mioma shubha.

en: Menstrual cycle irregular or painful.
uzL: Hayz sikli notekis yoki og'riqli.

en: Number of pregnancies and deliveries, complications.
uzL: Homiladorliklar va tug'ruqlar soni, asoratlar.

en: Infertility treated or evaluation performed.
uzL: Bepushtlik davolangan yoki tekshiruv o'tkazilgan.

en: Menopause or HRT taken.
uzL: Klimaks yoki GKT qabul qilgan.

en: Gynecological surgery (fibroid etc.) performed.
uzL: Ginekologik operatsiya (mioma va h.k.) o'tkazilgan.

en: Pain during urination, frequent urination, burning.
uzL: Siydik chiqarishda og'riq, tez-tez siyishga chiqish, kuyish.

en: Blood in urine (hematuria), visible or microscopic.
uzL: Siydikda qon (gematuriya), ko'rinadi yoki mikroskopik.

en: Urinary tract infection: fever, burning, frequent urination.
uzL: Siydik yo'llari infeksiyasi: isitma, kuyish, tez siyish.

en: Chronic kidney failure monitoring, creatinine elevated.
uzL: Surunkali buyrak yetishmovchiligi kuzatuvda, kreatinin oshgan.

en: On dialysis or preparing for dialysis.
uzL: Dializda yoki dializga tayyorgarlik.

en: Edema, hypertension and protein in urine — glomerulonephritis.
uzL: Oteki, gipertenziya va siydikda oqsil — glomerulonefrit.

en: Nephrology evaluation, urinalysis and creatinine needed.
uzL: Nefrologik tekshiruv, siydik tahlili va kreatinin kerak.

en: Swelling in face and legs, worse in face in morning.
uzL: Yuz va oyoqlarda shish, ertalab yuzda kuchayadi.

en: Back pain in kidney area, one or both sides.
uzL: Orqa bel sohasida og'riq, bir yoki ikkala tomonda.

en: Decreased or stopped urine output, oliguria.
uzL: Siydik kam chiqadi yoki to'xtab qoladi, oliguriya.

en: High blood pressure, uncontrolled, with kidney failure.
uzL: Qon bosimi yuqori, nazoratsiz, buyrak etishmovchiligi bilan.

en: Weakness, pallor, anemia — chronic kidney disease.
uzL: Zaiflik, rangparlik, anemiya — surunkali buyrak kasalligi.

en: Frequent urination (polyuria) and thirst, diabetes or kidney.
uzL: Ko'p siyish (poliuriya) va chanqash, diabet yoki buyrak.

en: Nephrotic syndrome: massive edema, protein loss.
uzL: Nefrotik sindrom: katta shish, oqsil yo'qotish.

en: Kidney stone suspected: flank pain episode, blood in urine.
uzL: Buyrak toshi shubha: belda og'riq xuruji, siydikda qon.

en: Kidney disease or urinary tract infection previously.
uzL: Buyrak kasalligi yoki siydik yo'llari infeksiyasi ilgari.

en: High blood pressure for years, uncontrolled.
uzL: Qon bosimi yuqori yillab, nazoratsiz.

en: Together with diabetes or heart disease.
uzL: Diabet yoki yurak kasalligi bilan birga.

en: Kidney stone experienced or treated.
uzL: Buyrak toshi o'tkazgan yoki davolangan.

en: Protein or blood identified in urinalysis.
uzL: Siydik tahlilida oqsil yoki qon aniqlangan.

en: Creatinine elevated, nephrologist monitoring.
uzL: Kreatinin oshgan, nefrolog kuzatuvda.

en: On dialysis or after transplant.
uzL: Dializ rejimida yoki transplantatsiya keyin.

en: Recurring headache, migraine or tension type, frequency increased recently.
uzL: Bosh og'rig'i takrorlanadi, migren yoki tension tipi, oxirgi oylarda chastotasi oshgan.

en: Numbness in hands or feet, tingling, "pins and needles" sensation, neuropathy suspected.
uzL: Qo'l yoki oyoqlarda uvishish, karaxtlik, "ignaq tegadi" hissi, neyropatiya shubha.

en: Migraine: one-sided headache, visual disturbance (aura), nausea.
uzL: Migren: bosh og'rig'i bir tomonda, ko'rish buzilishi (aura), ko'ngil aynishi.

en: Stroke suspected: paralysis, speech disorder, dizziness — urgent evaluation needed.
uzL: Stroke shubha: falaj, nutq buzilishi, bosh aylanishi — tez tekshiruv kerak.

en: Neuropathy: foot-hand numbness, pain, worse at night.
uzL: Neyropatiya: oyoq-qo'l uvishishi, og'riq, kechasi kuchayadi.

en: Parkinson suspected: tremor, slowness of movement, rigidity, gait difficulty.
uzL: Parkinson shubha: titroq, harakat sekinligi, qotish, yurish qiyin.

en: Disc herniation: neck or back pain, numbness in arm/leg.
uzL: Disk herniyasi: bo'yin yoki bel og'rig'i, uvishish qo'l/oyoqda.

en: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) history, follow-up or ongoing headache.
uzL: Bosh miya jarohati (YUT) o'tkazgan, keyingi kuzatuv yoki bosh og'rig'i davom etmoqda.

en: Vertigo, dizziness, tinnitus, BPPV or vestibular suspected.
uzL: Vertigo, bosh aylanishi, quloq shovqin, BPPV yoki vestibulyar shubha.

en: Tremor, hand shaking, at rest or with movement.
uzL: Tremor, qo'l titroqi, dam olishda yoki harakatda.

en: Myasthenia: muscle weakness, fatigue, eyelid drooping.
uzL: Miasteniya: mushak zaifligi, charchash, ko'z qopqog'i.

en: Brain tumor suspected, headache, vomiting.
uzL: Bosh miya o'simtasi ekv., bosh og'rig'i, qusish.

en: Dizziness, vertigo, unsteady gait, with or without tinnitus.
uzL: Bosh aylanishi, vertigo, beqaror yurish, quloq shovqin bilan yoki undan mustasno.

en: Encephalitis or meningitis suspected — urgent evaluation.
uzL: Encephalitis yoki meningitis ekv. — tez tekshiruv.

en: Cognitive decline, dementia suspected.
uzL: Kognitiv pasayish, demans shubha.

en: Radiculopathy: numbness from back to leg.
uzL: Radikulopatiya: beldan oyoqka uvishish.

en: Speech difficulty, tongue deviation, cannot find words, stroke suspected.
uzL: Gapirish qiyinlashishi, til chalg'ishi, so'zni topa olmaydi, stroke ekv.

en: Brief loss of consciousness, syncope, painless.
uzL: Qisqa muddatli hushdan ketish, sinkop, og'rig'siz.

en: Seizures (epileptic), unconsciousness, brief duration.
uzL: Tutilish (epileptik) xurujlari, ongsizlik, qisqa muddat.

en: Vision loss in one eye or one side, optic nerve or brain suspected.
uzL: Bir ko'zda yoki bir tomonda ko'rish pasayishi, ko'z o'qi yoki miya shubha.

en: Facial nerve palsy, mimic disorder, one-sided.
uzL: Yuz nervi falaji, mimika buzilishi, bir tomonda.

en: Sleep disorder, frequent nighttime awakenings, morning fatigue.
uzL: Uyqu buzilishi, tunda tez-tez uyg'onish, ertalab charchoq.

en: Memory decline, cannot concentrate, forgets recent events.
uzL: Xotira pasayishi, diqqatni jamlay olmaslik, yaqin vaqt hodisalarini unutadi.

en: Headache recurring for years, frequency increased recently.
uzL: Bosh og'rig'i yillab takrorlanib keladi, oxirgi oylarda chastotasi oshgan.

en: Symptoms worsen with sleep deprivation and work stress.
uzL: Uyqu yetishmasligi va ish stressi fonida simptomlar kuchayadi.

en: Spinal disc herniation treated, recurrence or new complaint.
uzL: Umurtqa pog'onasi disk herniyasi davolangan, recidiv yoki yangi shikoyat.

en: Neuropathy (diabetic or other) history.
uzL: Neyropatiya (diabetik yoki boshqa) tarixi bor.

en: Taking anticoagulants or antiaggregants, bleeding risk.
uzL: Antikoagulyantlar yoki antiagregantlar qabul qiladi, qon quyilishi xavfi.

en: Brain MRI/CT previously performed or currently needed.
uzL: Bosh miya MRT/KT ilgari o'tkazilgan yoki hozir kerak.

en: EEG or EMG results available.
uzL: EEG yoki EMG natijalari mavjud.

en: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) history, follow-up.
uzL: Bosh miya jarohati (YUT) o'tkazgan, keyingi kuzatuv.

en: Family history of migraine, epilepsy or stroke.
uzL: Oilada migren, epilepsiya yoki insult bor.

en: Migraine treated, preventive courses not completed.
uzL: Migren bo'yicha davolangan, profilaktika kurslari bajarilmagan.

en: Blood pressure changes accompanied by dizziness.
uzL: Qon bosimi o'zgarishi bosh aylanishi bilan birga kuzatiladi.

en: Epilepsy monitoring, following medication regimen.
uzL: Epilepsiya kuzatuvda, dori rejimiga rioya qiladi.

en: Long computer work, neck muscle strain.
uzL: Kompyuterda uzoq ishlash, bo'yin mushaklari zo'riqishi.

en: Stroke experienced, rehabilitation ongoing.
uzL: Stroke (insult) o'tkazgan, reabilitatsiya davom etmoqda.

en: Parkinson or tremor suspected, neurologist not yet seen.
uzL: Parkinson yoki tremor shubha, nevrolog hali ko'rmagan.

en: Vision loss, in one or both eyes.
uzL: Ko'rish pasayishi, bir yoki ikkala ko'zda.

en: Eye itching, redness, discharge.
uzL: Ko'z qichishishi, qizarish, ajralma.

en: Double vision (diplopia).
uzL: Bir narsani ikki ko'radi (diplopiya).

en: Curtain or spot in front of eye.
uzL: Ko'z oldida parda yoki chandiq.

en: Increased light sensitivity.
uzL: Yorug'likka sezgirlik oshgan.

en: Pain or pressure inside eye.
uzL: Ko'z ichida og'riq yoki bosim.

en: Glaucoma monitoring, using eye drops.
uzL: Glaukoma kuzatuvda, tomchilar qabul qiladi.

en: Cataract suspected, blurred vision.
uzL: Katarakta shubha, xira ko'rish.

en: Diabetic retinopathy, fundus examination done.
uzL: Diabetik retinopatiya, ko'z tubi tekshirilgan.

en: Ophthalmological evaluation needed.
uzL: Oftalmologik tekshiruv kerak.

en: Eye disease previously, glaucoma or cataract.
uzL: Ko'z kasalligi ilgari, glaukoma yoki katarakta.

en: Diabetes or hypertension present, fundus examined.
uzL: Diabet yoki gipertenziya bor, ko'z tubi tekshirilgan.

en: Eye surgery performed.
uzL: Ko'z operatsiyasi o'tkazilgan.

en: Back pain, worsens with movement, disc herniation suspected.
uzL: Bel og'rig'i, harakatda kuchayadi, disk herniyasi shubha.

en: Neck pain, radiating to arm with numbness.
uzL: Bo'yin og'rig'i, qo'lga uvishish tarqaladi.

en: After surgery (arthroplasty etc.) rehabilitation.
uzL: Jarrohlik (artroplastika va h.k.) keyin reabilitatsiya.

en: Muscle or ligament strain.
uzL: Mushak yoki ligament zo'riqishi.

en: Orthopedic evaluation, X-ray or MRI needed.
uzL: Ortopedik tekshiruv, rentgen yoki MRT kerak.

en: Knee or hip joint pain, with walking.
uzL: Tizza yoki son bo'g'imida og'riq, yurishda.

en: Shoulder pain, limited arm elevation.
uzL: Yelka og'rig'i, qo'lni ko'tarishda cheklangan.

en: Bone fracture or sprain, after trauma.
uzL: Suyak sinishi yoki chayqalish, travma keyin.

en: Joint swelling, redness, limited movement — arthritis.
uzL: Bo'g'im shishi, qizarish, harakat cheklangan — artrit.

en: Prolonged pain in foot or hand.
uzL: Oyoq yoki qo'lida uzoq davom etuvchi og'riq.

en: Follow-up after orthosis or cast.
uzL: Ortez yoki gipsdan keyin kuzatuv.

en: Osteoporosis, easy bone fracture, weight loss.
uzL: Osteoporoz, suyak sinishi oson, vazn tushgan.

en: Pain with rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis.
uzL: Revmatoid artrit yoki artroz bilan og'riq.

en: Back or neck surgery performed.
uzL: Bel yoki bo'yin operatsiyasi o'tkazilgan.

en: Trauma or bone fracture previously.
uzL: Travma yoki suyak sinishi ilgari.

en: Arthritis or osteoarthritis diagnosis.
uzL: Artrit yoki artroz tashxisi bor.

en: Osteoporosis identified, taking medications.
uzL: Osteoporoz aniqlangan, dorilar qabul qiladi.

en: Heavy physical work, much exertion.
uzL: Jismoniy ish og'ir, zo'riqish ko'p.

en: Persistent low mood, anhedonia, fatigue for more than 2 weeks — suspected major depression.
uzL: 2 haftadan ortiq davom etuvchi tushkunlik, hech narsadan zavq olmaslik, charchoq — asosiy depressiya shubhasi.

en: Excessive generalized worry, restlessness, palpitations or sweating — suspected anxiety disorder.
uzL: Doimiy tashvish, bezovtalik, yurak urishi yoki terlash — bezovtalik buzilishlari shubhasi.

en: Intrusive memories, nightmares, hypervigilance after trauma — PTSD features.
uzL: Travmadan keyin tasavvurlar, qo'rquvli tushlar, gigervojilantlik — PTSD alomatlari.

en: Severe food restriction or binge–purge cycles — suspected eating disorder.
uzL: Ovqatni keskin cheklash yoki ovqat yeb keyin qusish tsikllari — ovqatlanish buzilishlari shubhasi.

en: Progressive memory loss, disorientation, personality change — possible major neurocognitive disorder.
uzL: Xotira yo'qolishi, orientatsiya buzilishi, shaxs o'zgarishi — neyrokognitiv buzilish shubhasi.

en: Agitation, aggression, acute confusion — delirium or psychiatric emergency.
uzL: Hayajonlanish, agressiya, o'tkir chalkashlik — delirium yoki psixiatrik favqulodda holat.

en: Adverse effects of psychotropic drugs or poor adherence — medication review.
uzL: Psixotrop dorilar yon ta'siri yoki rejaga rioya qilmaslik — dori maslahati.

en: First-episode psychosis — urgent comprehensive psychiatric evaluation.
uzL: Birinchi marta psixoz — keng qamrovli psixiatrik baholash shoshilinch.

en: Prolonged grief with marked functional impairment — differential from depression.
uzL: Uzoq davom etgan qayg'u bilan funksional buzilish — depressiya va qayg'u farqi.

en: Child/adolescent: behavioral problems, school refusal, or self-harm — developmental assessment.
uzL: Bolada/yosh o'smanda: xulq-atvor muammolari, maktabdan qochish, o'ziga zarar — rivoj bahosi.

en: Recurrent panic attacks with palpitations, shortness of breath, fear of dying.
uzL: Panik xurujlari: yurak urishi, nafas yetishmasligi, o'lim qo'rquvi.

en: Elevated mood, reduced need for sleep, impulsive spending — manic or hypomanic features.
uzL: Ko'tarilgan kayfiyat, uyquga ehtiyoj kamayishi, impulsiv xarajatlar — manik yoki gipomanik alomatlar.

en: Auditory hallucinations, delusional ideas, social withdrawal — psychosis / possible schizophrenia spectrum disorder.
uzL: Ovozlar eshitish (akkustik gallutsinatsiya), debiya, ijtimoiy chekinish — psixoz / shizofreniya spektri shubhasi.

en: Suicidal ideation, plan, or self-harm urges — urgent safety assessment.
uzL: O'z joniga qasd qilish fikrlari, reja yoki o'ziga zarar yetkazish xohishi — xavfsizlikni baholash, shoshilinch.

en: Insomnia, early morning awakening, non-restorative sleep.
uzL: Uyqu buzilishi, erta uyg'onish, uyqudan keyin tiklanmaslik hissi.

en: Alcohol or substance use with craving, withdrawal symptoms, or inability to cut down.
uzL: Alkogol yoki moddalarni boshqarolmaslik, sustlashish, yoki ulardan qat'iy kamaytira olmaslik.

en: Poor concentration, decline in work or school performance — adult ADHD vs stress-related cognitive symptoms.
uzL: Diqqatni jamlashda qiyinchilik, ish yoki o'qishda pasayish — kattalarda ADHD yoki stressga bog'liq kognitiv alomatlar.

en: Obsessions and compulsive rituals interfering with daily life — OCD features.
uzL: Majburiy fikrlar va kunlik hayotga xalaqit beradigan ritual — OCD alomatlari.

en: Prior psychiatric diagnosis (depression, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia spectrum, etc.).
uzL: Oldin qo'yilgan psixiatrik tashxis (depressiya, bipolyar buzilish, shizofreniya spektri va h.k.).

en: Previous psychiatric hospitalization or suicide attempt.
uzL: Oldin psixiatrik statsionarda bo'lgan yoki o'ziga qasd urinish tarixi.

en: Family history of mental illness or suicide.
uzL: Oilada ruhiy kasallik yoki o'ziga qasd tarixi.

en: Current psychotropic medications (names, doses, adherence).
uzL: Hozirgi psixotrop dorilar (nomlari, dozalari, qabul qilish intizomi).

en: Substance use (alcohol, cannabis, stimulants) — pattern and frequency.
uzL: Modda ishlatish (alkogol, kanabinoidlar, stimulyatorlar) — naqsh va chastota.

en: Major psychosocial stressors — loss, conflict, financial strain.
uzL: Psixosotsial og'ir stressorlar — yo'qotish, nizo, moliyaviy qiyinchilik.

en: Somatic conditions affecting mental state (thyroid disease, B12 deficiency, epilepsy).
uzL: Kayfiyat va fikrlashga ta'sir qiluvchi somatik kasalliklar (qalqon bezi, B12 yetishmovchiligi, epilepsiya).

en: Prior psychotherapy, TMS, or ECT.
uzL: Oldin psixoterapiya, TMS yoki EKT o'tkazilgan.

en: Prolonged cough, dry or productive, worse at night.
uzL: Yo'tal uzoq davom etadi, quruq yoki balg'amli, kechasi kuchayadi.

en: Shortness of breath, worsens with physical activity, climbing stairs.
uzL: Nafas qisilishi, jismoniy harakatda kuchayadi, zinadan chiqishda.

en: Chest tightness, angina suspected or pleurisy.
uzL: Ko'krak qafasida siqilish, stenokardiya ekv. yoki plevrit.

en: Acute bronchitis: fever, cough, after URI.
uzL: O'tkir bronxit: isitma, yo'tal, O'RVI dan keyin.

en: Allergic cough, seasonal or dust-related.
uzL: Allergik yo'tal, mavsumiy yoki changdan.

en: Pneumonia history, ongoing shortness of breath after.
uzL: Pnevmoniya o'tkazgan, keyin nafas qisilishi davom etadi.

en: Tuberculosis suspected: prolonged cough, weight loss, night sweats.
uzL: Tuberkulyoz ekv.: uzoq yo'tal, vazn tushishi, kecha terlash.

en: Pleural effusion suspected, shortness of breath and chest pain.
uzL: Plevral effuziya shubha, nafas qisilishi va ko'krak og'rig'i.

en: Asthma: episodes, with allergen or exertion.
uzL: Astma: xurujlar, allergen yoki zo'riqishda.

en: Interstitial lung disease suspected.
uzL: Interstitsial o'pka kasalligi shubha.

en: Pulmonary evaluation, X-ray or CT needed.
uzL: Pulmonologik tekshiruv, rentgen yoki KT kerak.

en: Chest pain, worsens with breathing, pleurisy or muscle.
uzL: Ko'krak og'rig'i, nafas olishda kuchayadi, plevrit yoki mushak.

en: Air hunger, suffocation feeling, with stress or at rest.
uzL: Havo yetishmasligi, bo'g'ilish hissi, stressda yoki dam olishda.

en: Sputum production, color change, green or yellow.
uzL: Balg'am ajralishi, rang o'zgarishi, yashil yoki sariq.

en: Fever, cough, shortness of breath together, pneumonia suspected.
uzL: Isitma, yo'tal, nafas qisilishi bilan birga, pnevmoniya shubha.

en: Wheezing, expiratory wheeze, bronchial asthma.
uzL: Vizillik, nafas chiqarishda xirillash, bronxial astma.

en: Bloody cough, pleural or bronchial suspected.
uzL: Qon aralash yo'tal, plevra yoki bronxial shubha.

en: Chronic cough, smoking history, COPD suspected.
uzL: Surunkali yo'tal, chekish anamnezi, KOAB shubha.

en: Nocturnal apnea, episodes, sleep apnea.
uzL: Tunda nafas to'xtashi, xurujlar, uyqu apnoe.

en: Long smoking history, still smoking or quit.
uzL: Chekish staji uzoq, hozir ham chekadi yoki to'xtatgan.

en: Chronic bronchitis or COPD diagnosis, bronchodilators.
uzL: Surunkali bronxit yoki KOAB tashxisi bor, bronxodilatatorlar.

en: Pneumonia experienced several times.
uzL: Pnevmoniya bir necha marta o'tkazgan.

en: Tuberculosis suspected or in family, evaluation performed.
uzL: Tuberkulyoz ekv. yoki oilada bor, tekshiruv o'tkazilgan.

en: Asthma from childhood or later, allergen known.
uzL: Astma bolalikdan yoki keyinroq, allergen ma'lum.

en: Allergic rhinitis, seasonal or perennial.
uzL: Allergik rinit, mavsumiy yoki doimiy.

en: Chest X-ray or CT previously performed.
uzL: Ko'krak rentgeni yoki KT ilgari o'tkazilgan.

en: Sleep apnea suspected or CPAP.
uzL: Uyquda nafas to'xtashi (apnoe) shubha yoki CPAP.

en: Joint pain and swelling, symmetric in both hands/feet.
uzL: Bo'g'imlarda og'riq va shish, ikkala qo'l/oyoqda simmetrik.

en: Morning stiffness, improves with movement.
uzL: Ertalab qotish, harakatdan keyin yaxshilanadi.

en: Skin rash, on face or with sun exposure.
uzL: Terida toshma, yuzda yoki quyosh ta'sirida.

en: General weakness, fatigue, subfebrile fever.
uzL: Umumiy zaiflik, charchash, isitma subfebril.

en: Rheumatoid arthritis monitoring, MTX or other drugs.
uzL: Revmatoid artrit kuzatuvda, MTX yoki boshqa dorilar.

en: Osteoarthritis: knee or hip joint pain.
uzL: Artroz: tizza yoki son bo'g'imida og'riq.

en: Osteoporosis, fracture risk.
uzL: Osteoporoz, suyak sinishi xavfi.

en: Behcet or other vasculitis suspected.
uzL: Behchet yoki boshqa vaskulit shubha.

en: Rheumatological evaluation and blood test needed.
uzL: Revmatologik tekshiruv va qon tahlili kerak.

en: Rheumatoid arthritis or other autoimmune disease.
uzL: Revmatoid artrit yoki boshqa autoimmun kasallik.

en: Joint surgery or endoprosthesis.
uzL: Bo'g'im jarrohligi yoki endoprotez.

en: Taking corticosteroids or MTX.
uzL: Kortikosteroidlar yoki MTX qabul qilgan.

en: General malaise, easy fatigue, no fever or subfebrile.
uzL: Umumiy holsizlik, tez charchash, isitma yo'q yoki subfebril.

en: Prolonged fever, with cough or other infection signs.
uzL: Isitma uzoq davom etadi, yo'tal yoki boshqa infeksiya belgilari bilan.

en: URI: fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat.
uzL: O'RVI: isitma, yo'tal, burun oqishi, bo'g'oz og'rig'i.

en: Breathing difficulty, chest tightness, worsens with physical activity.
uzL: Nafas olish qiyin, ko'krak siqilishi, jismoniy harakatda kuchayadi.

en: Chest pain, worsens with breathing, pleurisy or muscle pain.
uzL: Ko'krak og'rig'i, nafas olishda kuchayadi, plevrit yoki mushak og'rig'i.

en: Enlarged lymph nodes, neck or elsewhere, painful or painless.
uzL: Lymph tugunlari kattalashgan, bo'yin yoki boshqa joyda, og'riqli yoki og'riqsiz.

en: Pneumonia suspected: fever, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain.
uzL: Pnevmoniya shubha: isitma, yo'tal, nafas qisilishi, ko'krak og'rig'i.

en: Chronic bronchitis or COPD, cough and sputum prolonged.
uzL: Surunkali bronxit yoki KOAB, yo'tal va balg'am uzoq davom etadi.

en: Allergic rhinitis, bronchial asthma, seasonal or perennial.
uzL: Allergik rinit, bronxial astma, mavsumiy yoki doimiy.

en: General check-up, preventive examination, no specific complaints.
uzL: Umumiy tekshiruv, profilaktik ko'rik, hech qanday aniq shikoyat yo'q.

en: Blood clot or thrombosis history.
uzL: Qon quyqasi yoki tromboz tarixi.

en: Immunity decreased, frequent infections.
uzL: Immunitet pasaygan, tez-tez infeksiya.

en: Loss of appetite, weight loss, weakness — chronic or new.
uzL: Ishtaha yo'q, vazn tushdi, zaiflik — surunkali yoki yangi.

en: Heaviness in liver or gallbladder area.
uzL: Jigar yoki o't sohasida og'irilik.

en: Kidney or urinary tract complaints.
uzL: Buyrak yoki siydik yo'llari shikoyatlari.

en: X-ray or CT results available.
uzL: Rentgen yoki KT natijalari mavjud.

en: Joint pain and stiffness, swelling, worse with movement.
uzL: Bo'g'imlarda og'riq va qotish, shish, harakatda kuchayadi.

en: Dry or productive cough, shortness of breath, URI or bronchitis.
uzL: Yo'tal quruq yoki balg'amli, nafas qisilishi, O'RVI yoki bronxit.

en: Skin rash, itching, allergic reaction or infection suspected.
uzL: Terida toshmalar, qichishish, allergik reaksiya yoki infektsiya shubha.

en: Sleep and mood disorder, depression or anxiety suspected.
uzL: Uyqu va kayfiyat buzilishi, depressiya yoki bezovtalik shubha.

en: Variable blood pressure, headache, high or low pressure.
uzL: Qon bosimi o'zgaruvchan, bosh og'rig'i, bosim yuqori yoki past.

en: Anemia: weakness, pallor, dizziness, pale lips.
uzL: Anemiya: zaiflik, rangparlik, bosh aylanishi, lablar oq.

en: Condition worsened on chronic disease background, compensation disrupted.
uzL: Surunkali kasallik fonida ahvol yomonlashdi, kompensatsiya buzilgan.

en: General condition worsened in recent month on chronic disease background.
uzL: Surunkali kasalliklar fonida so'nggi oyda umumiy ahvol yomonlashgan.

en: Frequent URI in last 2-3 months.
uzL: So'nggi 2–3 oy davomida tez-tez O'RVI bilan og'rigan.

en: Tuberculosis suspected or in family, evaluation recommended.
uzL: Tuberkulyoz ekv. yoki oilada bor, tekshiruv tavsiya etilgan.

en: Physical activity insufficient, sleep regimen disrupted.
uzL: Jismoniy faollik yetarli emas, uyqu rejimi buzilgan.

en: Complete blood count and biochemistry needed.
uzL: Qon umumiy tahlili va biokimyosi kerak.

en: Chest X-ray or CT previously performed.
uzL: Ko'krak rentgeni yoki KT ilgari o'tkazilgan.

en: Dietary regimen disrupted, daily ration unbalanced.
uzL: Ovqatlanish tartibi buzilgan, kunlik ratsion balanssiz.

en: Self-treatment at home, medications taken without control.
uzL: Uyda o'z-o'zini davolash, dorilarni nazoratsiz qabul qilgan.

en: Not attending preventive check-ups for long time.
uzL: Profilaktik ko'riklarga uzoq vaqtdan beri qatnashmagan.

en: Allergic history positive, seasonal rhinitis or rashes.
uzL: Allergik anamnez ijobiy, mavsumiy rinit yoki toshmalar.

en: Anemia previously identified with laboratory changes.
uzL: Anemiya bo'yicha ilgari laborator o'zgarishlar aniqlangan.

en: Vaccinations not according to schedule or not performed.
uzL: Emlashlar kalendarga mos emas yoki o'tkazilmagan.

en: Chronic bronchitis or COPD, taking bronchodilators.
uzL: Surunkali bronxit yoki KOAB, bronxodilatatorlar qabul qiladi.

en: Pneumonia experienced, X-ray improved, follow-up.
uzL: Pnevmoniya o'tkazgan, rentgen da yaxshilangan, keyingi kuzatuv.

en: Pain or burning during urination.
uzL: Siydik chiqarishda og'riq yoki kuyish.

en: Frequent urination (pollakiuria), also at night.
